robodk_reference.tcp_injection_note: Phase-0 centered-mapping set_tcp pose: translation=tcp.offset_m, rotation=shortest-arc(+Z -> tcp.nozzle_axis_local). Round-trip verified against oracle FK.

post_mapping_transform.description: Transforms are applied to mapped world TCP targets before IK: translate, optional Z rotation, then translate again.

tcp.description: The G-code path is followed by the nozzle TCP, not the tool0 origin.
tcp.nozzle_axis_description: Nozzle facing direction in the tool0/end-effector frame.
tcp.normal_mapping_description: G-code normals are mapped to Isaac as world=[J, I, K] to match the XYZ position mapping.
tcp.target_nozzle_axis_description: Desired nozzle direction in Isaac world coordinates. For G-code normals, this is per waypoint.

ik_path.target_description: Desired nozzle TCP positions in Isaac world coordinates.
